claim: Training a fresh real-wiring male-CNS core (learned Dale-preserving edges) into the frozen v3 trunk lowers held-out loss compared with the trunk with no CNS core.

protocol.notes: Full male-CNS type graph (11,751 types, 3,830,931 edges). Only the lab core trains; trunk frozen (v3). Every arm starts from the same function (gate 0) with the same seed-determined core init, rows, order and schedule.

notes: Positive control / sanity check: if a trained core does not beat no core, H-CNS-001 cannot be informative. The 'none' arm has nothing to train (its metrics do not depend on the seed). Caveat: the v3 trunk was trained with its own core, so part of any gain is the fresh core re-learning that role.
